title: Deliver Me from My Enemies

questions.question: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise up against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:1 (ESV): "Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise up against me;"

questions.question: Deliver me from those who work evil, and save me from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:2 (ESV): "Deliver me from those who work evil, and save me from bloodthirsty men."

questions.question: For behold, they lie in wait for my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:3 (ESV): "For behold, they lie in wait for my life;"

questions.question: You, O Lord God of hosts, are God of Israel. Awake to punish all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:5 (ESV): "...Awake to punish all the nations; spare none of those who treacherously plot evil."

questions.question: Spare none of those who treacherously plot what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:5 (ESV): "...spare none of those who treacherously plot evil."

questions.question: Each evening they come back, howling like dogs and prowling about the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:6 (ESV): "Each evening they come back, howling like dogs and prowling about the city."

questions.question: There are swords in their lips—for "Who," they think, "will what?"
But you, O Lord, laugh at them; you hold all the nations in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:8 (ESV): "But you, O Lord, laugh at them; you hold all the nations in derision."

questions.question: O my Strength, I will watch for you, for you, O God, are my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:9 (ESV): "O my Strength, I will watch for you, for you, O God, are my fortress."

questions.question: My God in his steadfast love will meet me; God will let me look in triumph on my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:10 (ESV): "...God will let me look in triumph on my enemies."

questions.question: Kill them not, lest my people forget; make them totter by your power and bring them down, O Lord, our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:11 (ESV): "...bring them down, O Lord, our shield!"

questions.question: For the sin of their mouths, the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:12 (ESV): "...let them be trapped in their pride."

questions.question: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:13 (ESV): "Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more,"

questions.question: But I will sing of your strength; I will sing aloud of your steadfast love in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59:16 (ESV): "But I will sing of your strength; I will sing aloud of your steadfast love in the morning."

questions.question: This Psalm was written when Saul sent men to watch David's house to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 59 Title: "...when Saul sent men to watch his house in order to kill him."

key_verse_text: But I will sing of your strength; I will sing aloud of your steadfast love in the morning. For you have been to me a fortress and a refuge in the day of my distress.
